info.name: Landlord

query.description: Admin only: view a specific landlord's dashboard by UUID. Ignored for non-admin callers.

request.description:
Returns all landlord dashboard data in a single request. All queries run in parallel.

Role: LANDLORD or ADMIN.

Sections returned:
- stats: property counts (total, published, unpublished, available, unavailable), total views, total favourites
- recentActivity: last 10 favourites on the landlord's properties (who favourited which property)
- topProperties: top 5 properties by view count with favourite counts

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Filter by published status (true/false). Omit to include all.
Filter by availability (true/false). Omit to include all.
Search by property title (case-insensitive partial match).
Admin only: view a specific landlord's properties by UUID. Ignored for non-admin callers.

request.description:
Returns the landlord's properties with per-property performance stats. Supports pagination, filtering by published/available status, and title search.

Role: LANDLORD or ADMIN.

Each property includes: title, price, status flags, view count, favourite count, report count, recent reports (ordered by newest first), cover image, location, and property type.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Returns full detail for a single property owned by the authenticated landlord. Unlike the public property detail endpoint, this does not filter by published status and includes report data with reporter info.

Role: LANDLORD or ADMIN.

Ownership: The requesting user must own the property, or be an ADMIN.

Includes: all property fields, all images (with isCover flag), property type, district/province, amenities, house rules (all rules with is_allow boolean), parkings, reports (with reporter user info), favourite count, report count.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Public endpoint — no authentication required.

Returns a landlord's public profile (name, avatar, email, phone numbers, member since date, total published listings) along with a paginated list of their published properties.

Returns 404 if the user does not exist or is not a LANDLORD.
